heading: Hi there again, I'm Lucy Lu! 👀

blocks.html: As a designer deeply passionate about emerging technology and creative problem-solving, I have explored both digital and tangible space, and I enjoy bringing order and meanings to the experience crafted.

After working in the architectural filed for several years, I decided to expand my focus from architectural design to UX design to develop products that satisfy people’s needs without geographical constraints.

Now, as a product designer, I am excited to be working in a field where I can combine my passion for creating enjoyable experiences with my skills in design and problem-solving. I look forward to collaborating with other professionals in the industry to build meaningful experiences, continuing my role as a creative thinker and effective problem-solver.
🎓 Master of Landscape Architecture @ The University of Hongkong
